content.text: All four preferred elements are satisfied; no redline needed.

input.quote: 9.4 Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form without cause by delivering the written notice specified in Section 29.4. Customer owes only accrued Fees, and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees for the period after termination.
input.rationale: Section 9.4 gives Customer an unconditional right to terminate the Agreement or any Order Form without cause, and Section 29.4 fixes that notice at thirty days before the effective termination date, meeting the preferred 30-day standard. Customer owes only accrued Fees (no early-termination fee or penalty anywhere in Sections 7, 9, 10 or 11), and Vendor must refund prepaid Fees for the post-termination period, which is a pro-rata refund (reinforced by Section 10.2). No provision anywhere grants Vendor any termination-for-convenience or without-cause right during the three-year term (Section 8.1); Vendor's termination rights are limited to material breach (9.1) and insolvency (9.2), and even the non-renewal mechanic in Section 8.2 is Customer-only. The clause therefore meets the preferred position in full.
